entries.zh: 完结；终了、了结（顷刻之间）
丧亡；丧事、居丧（人死事毕）
entries.notes: 「丧」与西语 acabado/deshecho 的对应取人死事毕、丧亡之义，属推断。

entries.zh: 将尽；残存而近终了（时光流逝、事物到头）
entries.en: to be nearly over; to draw to an end (as time passes)

entries.zh: 残灯；灯节将尽、灯油耗尽（二月节期结束）
entries.en: the waning lanterns; the February festival draws to a close; the lamp oil gives out
entries.notes: 「二月节期」在马尼拉语境或指华人灯节/新年收尾，与「残灯」「灯油耗尽」的关联属推断。

entries.zh: 任满；任期届满（法官、主教等职任终了）
entries.en: to complete one's term of office (of a judge or prelate)

entries.zh: 定叠了；办妥、停当（做得好）

entries.en: the matter is settled; to finish with it

entries.zh: 断根；根绝、彻底了结（官司断根）
entries.en: to root out; to end (a lawsuit) at the root
to come to a good end; to bear a result
to exhaust; to finish to the very end

entries.zh: 衰微；衰竭将尽、不剩盈余
entries.en: waning; dwindled, with nothing left over
entries.notes: 西语「acabado que no sobra（尽而不余）」与「衰微」为近义推断。

entries.zh: 随手成；信手即成、轻易完成
entries.en: readily accomplished; done with a turn of the hand
entries.notes: 「随手成」侧重轻易而成，西语「perfectamente hecho」侧重圆满，释义折中。

entries.zh: 缴结；结清、了结（账目、事务）
事明白；事情清楚、了结明白
entries.en: the matter is clear; clarified and concluded

entries.zh: 易过；容易过去、轻易了结
entries.en: to pass easily; to be over easily
to hush; to quiet one who is crying
entries.notes: H 栏「晴」本义天晴，与 acallar（止哭、使安静）不合，疑字形或原稿有误，暂按「使平静」解，释义存疑。
